# apple_scm_repositories (Data Source)

Lists the source code repositories connected to Xcode Cloud: every one, or those of a product.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_scm_repositories" "all" {}

data "apple_scm_repositories" "product" {
  product_id = data.apple_ci_products.app.products[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `product_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of an Xcode Cloud product, to list its primary and additional repositories.

### Read-Only

- `repositories` (Attributes List) The repositories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))

<a id="nestedatt--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories`

Read-Only:

- `default_branch_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the default branch's git reference.
- `http_clone_url` (String) URL the repository clones from over HTTPS.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the repository.
- `owner_name` (String) Owner of the repository, e.g. the organization.
- `primary` (Boolean) With `product_id`: whether this is the product's primary repository. Null otherwise.
- `repository_name` (String) Name of the repository.
- `scm_provider_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the source control provider.
- `ssh_clone_url` (String) URL the repository clones from over SSH.
